2609.05663.title: What LLM Trading Agents Actually Do in Production: A Six-Month, Population-Scale Record from Two Fleets
2609.05663.paper_summary: We present a continuous, population-scale measurement record of autonomous language-model trading agents operating in production across two systems with one design lineage: DX Terminal Pro (3,505 user-funded vaults trading real ETH in Base memecoin markets for 21 days, February to March 2026) and the DXAP live alpha fleet (500 to 599 user-created agents all-history, 91 to 117 concurrently active, trading Hyperliquid perpetuals, June to August 2026). The record spans roughly six months, 7.5M single-model invocations with about 300K onchain actions, and a further 231,638 multi-tool turns producing 14,596 fills. Four findings carry the paper. First, the operating layer determines behavior more than anything written in strategy text: a risk slider explains leverage (+0.425 per level), agent fixed effects absorb 60% of variance, and a leaderboard render boundary causally routes selection (regression discontinuity 1.75x at the top-3 cut). Second, sizing is volatility-blind: median leverage is 5.0x in every volatility sextile, and one posture-slider cell (11% of the book) holds 62% of liquidations. Third, agents capture almost none of the upside they reach: 43.2% of positions saw at least +300 bps of favorable excursion within 24h, yet 49.3% of those closed with a negative trade return; a mechanical bracket recovers +39.0 bps per position. Fourth, neither fleet shows a directional edge. The DXAP fleet is not profitable and trails a matched Hyperliquid retail benchmark (41% vs. 50% roundtrip win rate). A paired-replay league of frontier models on 416 captured production scenarios finds decision quality statistically indistinguishable at this horizon, while choice stability differs sharply across model families. Every headline survives day-clustered inference, permutation nulls, and a common-fee restatement; the paper closes with a 17-rule methodology canon bought with our own retractions.
2609.05663.paper_summary_zh: 我們呈現了一個持續的、以人口為基礎的測量記錄，記錄了在生產中運行的自主語言模型交易代理商，這些代理商在兩個系統中運作，具有相同的設計血統：DX Terminal Pro（3,505個用戶資助的金庫在Base memecoin市場上交易真實ETH，持續21天，從2026年2月到3月）和DXAP實時alpha艦隊（500到599個用戶創建的代理商，所有歷史，91到117個同時活躍，交易Hyperliquid永續合約，從2026年6月到8月）。該記錄大約涵蓋六個月，7.5M單模型調用，約300K鏈上行動，以及進一步的231,638次多工具回合，產生14,596次成交。四個發現構成了本文的核心。首先，操作層比策略文本中寫的任何內容更能決定行為：風險滑塊解釋了槓桿（每級+0.425），代理的固定效應吸收了60%的變異，排行榜的呈現邊界因果性地引導了選擇（回歸不連續性在前3名切割處為1.75倍）。其次，規模對波動性是盲目的：每個波動性六分位數的中位槓桿為5.0倍，且一個姿勢滑塊單元（佔書籍的11%）持有62%的清算。第三，代理幾乎沒有捕捉到他們達到的任何上行：43.2%的頭寸在24小時內至少看到+300個基點的有利波動，但其中49.3%以負交易回報結束；一個機械性括號每個頭寸回收+39.0個基點。第四，兩個艦隊都沒有顯示出方向性優勢。DXAP艦隊不盈利，並且落後於匹配的Hyperliquid零售基準（41%對50%的回合贏率）。在416個捕獲的生產場景中，前沿模型的配對重放聯盟發現決策質量在這一範疇內統計上無法區分，而選擇穩定性在模型家族之間有明顯差異。每個標題都經受住了日聚類推斷、置換虛無和共同費用重述的考驗；本文以我們自己撤回的17條規則方法論典範作結。
